stem: Why did the young seagull fail to fly away with his two brothers and his sister?
options: His wings were shorter than the wings of his siblings.
He felt certain that his wings would never support him.
His parents had forbidden him to leave the ledge yet.
He had hurt one of his wings while running to the brink.
explanation: Correct option: (B). The story says that when he looked at the great expanse of sea far below, he 'felt certain that his wings would never support him', so he ran back to his hole. Option A reverses the text: his sister's wings were 'far shorter than his own'. His parents actually urged him to fly, so C is wrong, and nothing in the story says he was injured, so D is wrong.

stem: How did the young seagull's parents first react when he would not fly?
options: They brought him fish on the ledge every few hours.
They flew to another cliff and left him there for good.
They scolded him and threatened to let him starve.
